regional.description: Detailed boundaries for UT of Jammu and Kashmir, UT of Ladakh, Line of Control (LoC), Line of Actual Control (LAC), and surrounding disputed zones

cartographic_treatment.UT-JK: Solid blue stroke with translucent fill; recognized Indian administrative territory post-2019
cartographic_treatment.UT-LA: Solid purple stroke with translucent fill; recognized Indian administrative territory post-2019
cartographic_treatment.LINE-LOC: Prominent dashed red-amber line (8px dash, 6px gap); 1972 Simla Agreement Line of Control
cartographic_treatment.LINE-LAC: Prominent dashed orange line (6px dash, 6px gap); Line of Actual Control separating Ladakh from Aksai Chin
cartographic_treatment.DISP-PAK-KASHMIR: Muted gray dashed outline with faint fill; Pakistan-administered Kashmir (Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan), excluded from ordinary Indian administrative territory
cartographic_treatment.DISP-CHN-AKSAI: Muted slate dashed outline with faint fill; China-administered Aksai Chin, excluded from ordinary Indian administrative territory
cartographic_treatment.DISP-SIACHEN: Demarcated glacial zone north of NJ9842 along the Actual Ground Position Line (AGPL)

national_overview.description: National overview showing all 36 States and Union Territories with J&K and Ladakh separately identified and disputed zones excluded from ordinary state fills

disclaimer: Cartographic Disclaimer: Administrative boundaries, designations, and cartographic representation of the Line of Control (LoC), Line of Actual Control (LAC), and associated zones are provided for spatial orientation and hydrological modeling. They do not imply official legal endorsement, sovereign determination, or border demarcation by the system or its contributors. Dotted and dashed lines represent approximate de facto lines of control.
